title: This pilot just ejected. His jet didn't. (F-106 Cornfield Bomber)
source: Google Flow (Omni 1.1 Flash 720p clips; Nano Banana Pro images, 768x1376); not produced by the factory

scenes.note: HOOK. Pilot under parachute at top, empty F-106 far below flying level, from frame 0. Jet shrinks toward lower right. Extra shadow appears bottom-left in the 2nd half.
Two F-106 in a mock dogfight, vapour trails over Rocky Mountains.

Flat spin seen from above (second generation, stricter prompt). A small side element at the tail on ~1-2.5 s appears in both runs, most likely the fin while the jet is rolled; later seconds are clean.
Cockpit over the shoulder, gloved hands on the stick, red warning lights. Horizon is rotated ~90 deg (spin).
Canopy lifts off, seat with pilot fires up on a rocket plume. At the end a figure/seat remains visible in the cockpit.
Single F-106 flying alone, open cockpit empty. Jet is rotated nose-down in frame.
Nose-high spin turns into level flight, ends head-on flying at the camera. Second generation made from the first frame only (no last frame). Cockpit is small and not clearly occupied.
View from the cockpit of a second jet, empty F-106 alongside in formation.
Pilot hanging under orange-and-white parachute, looking down, legs dangling.
Empty jet glides low, touches the snow on its belly, powder snow, slides to a stop. Readable U.S. AIR FORCE on fuselage (as in the real photo).
REAL PHOTO, not generated. The montage uses it as-is with the label 'REAL PHOTO 1970'.
Sheriff in sheepskin coat walks through snow toward the jet, exhaust vapour, sheriff car with star.
Sheriff at the cockpit, jet creeps forward, snow sprays, he jumps back. Nose gear is visible (brief says gear up).
Sheriff and two farmers in winter coats watching the jet in the snow, golden light. Jet is a distant dark silhouette.
Fuselage without wings strapped on a railroad flatcar, snowy Montana. Fin is painted red.
Repaired F-106 on a sunny flight line, 1970s ground crew.
Mustached pilot climbs the boarding ladder into the cockpit. A figure is already visible in the cockpit at the start.
F-106 hanging in a museum hall, visitors looking up.
ENDING. Silhouette of the jet flies away into an orange sunset over snowy plains.
